name: Goldkine x 5 Prerolls | Lemon Headz
description: Lemon Headz is an hybrid strain that strikes a perfect balance between mental clarity and deep-body relaxation. A cross between Lemon G and Face Off OG BX1, it offers a bright, citrusy flavor profile with earthy and floral undertones. Dominant terpenes limonene, terpinolene, and myrcene combine to create a euphoric yet focused experience that gradually settles into calm. This strain is ideal for evening use or moments when you want to stay present while letting go of stress. Whether you're kicking back after work or seeking creative clarity, Lemon Headz delivers a smooth, flavorful ride with lasting comfort.
